query: S9 流的系统错误消息，什么情况下发、什么情况下不发？Message Fault 和 Communications Fault 的区别是什么？
gold_standard: Stream 9 用于告知 host 收到的消息块无法处理或事务（接收）定时器超时，只指示 Message Fault 或 Communications Fault，不指示 Communications Failure。Message Fault：收到因内容、上下文或长度问题而无法处理的消息；Communications Fault：未收到预期消息（事务定时器或会话定时器超时）；发生 Communications Failure 时不发送任何 Stream 9 消息。
success_criteria: 答出两类 Fault 的区别 + Communications Failure 时不发 S9。
evidence: --[p74]-- This stream provides a method of informing the host that a received message block cannot be handled, or that a timeout on a transaction (receive) timer has occurred. The messages indicate either Message Faults or Communications Faults, but they do not indicate Communications Failures. Message Fault: A Message Fault occurs when the system receives a message which it cannot process because of a fault that arises from the content, context, or length of the message. Communications Fault: A Communications Fault occurs when the system does not receive an expected message (when a transaction timer or a conversation timer has expired). In the event of a Communications Failure, no Stream 9 message is sent.
